fields.title: Clinical Research
fields.description: Design rigorous clinical studies, manage research protocols, and interpret evidence for better healthcare decisions.

fields.title: Medical AI & Digital Health
fields.description: Apply artificial intelligence, data analytics, and digital health methods responsibly in medical research.

fields.title: Evidence Synthesis
fields.description: Find, assess, synthesize, and communicate evidence through systematic reviews and meta-analysis.

fields.title: Scientific Communication
fields.description: Turn complex research into clear manuscripts, reports, presentations, and publishable scientific narratives.

fields.title: Research Ethics & Integrity
fields.description: Build trustworthy research practices around ethics, governance, reproducibility, and publication integrity.

fields.title: Clinical Trial Design & Protocol Development
fields.description: Learn how to frame a clinical research question, select an appropriate study design, develop a defensible protocol, and plan outcomes that can produce reliable evidence.
fields.short_description: Design clear, ethical, and analysis-ready clinical trials.
fields.objectives:
Translate a clinical question into a research protocol
Choose between common trial designs and endpoints
Plan recruitment, bias control, and data quality
Prepare a protocol structure suitable for review
fields.requirements:
Basic familiarity with medical research terminology
No prior programming experience required
fields.target_audience: Clinicians, research coordinators, public-health professionals, and postgraduate researchers

fields.title: Biostatistics for Clinical Research
fields.description: Build practical statistical reasoning for clinical studies, from descriptive summaries and uncertainty to regression, power, and transparent interpretation of results.
fields.short_description: Use statistics confidently to interpret clinical evidence.
fields.objectives:
Summarize clinical datasets with appropriate descriptive measures
Choose and interpret common statistical tests
Understand confidence intervals, effect sizes, and power
Communicate statistical results without overstating claims
fields.requirements:
Comfort with percentages and basic algebra
A clinical or research context is helpful but not required
fields.target_audience: Medical researchers, clinicians, data managers, and graduate students

fields.title: Systematic Reviews & Evidence Synthesis
fields.description: Move from a focused research question to a reproducible search, critical appraisal, evidence table, and clear synthesis suitable for clinical decision-making.
fields.short_description: Plan reproducible reviews that turn literature into evidence.
fields.objectives:
Formulate answerable review questions
Build transparent search and screening workflows
Assess risk of bias and certainty of evidence
Present a synthesis that supports responsible decisions
fields.requirements:
Basic literature-search experience is recommended
Access to a reference manager is helpful
fields.target_audience: Systematic reviewers, librarians, clinicians, and evidence-based medicine learners

fields.title: Medical AI & Clinical Data Analytics
fields.description: Explore responsible machine learning for healthcare data, including dataset quality, clinical context, validation, bias, explainability, and safe communication of model results.
fields.short_description: Apply responsible AI methods to real clinical data questions.
fields.objectives:
Identify common sources of bias in clinical datasets
Prepare and validate data for research analysis
Compare useful model evaluation strategies
Explain limitations and risks to clinical stakeholders
fields.requirements:
Basic Python or data-analysis experience
Foundational clinical research knowledge is useful
fields.target_audience: Clinical data scientists, health researchers, informaticians, and AI practitioners

fields.title: Scientific & Medical Manuscript Writing
fields.description: Develop a publishable scientific manuscript from research question to discussion, using clear structure, evidence-aware language, effective tables and figures, and responsible AI assistance.
fields.short_description: Turn rigorous research into a clear, publishable manuscript.
fields.objectives:
Structure an IMRaD manuscript for the intended audience
Write precise abstracts, results, and discussions
Use tables and figures to clarify evidence
Apply responsible AI support without compromising authorship or integrity
fields.requirements:
A research project, dataset, or manuscript idea to develop
Basic academic writing experience
fields.target_audience: Medical writers, clinicians, researchers, and postgraduate students

fields.title: Research Ethics, GCP & Publication Integrity
fields.description: Strengthen the trustworthiness of health research through informed consent, governance, Good Clinical Practice, data stewardship, authorship, peer review, and publication integrity.
fields.short_description: Build trustworthy research from protocol to publication.
fields.objectives:
Recognize core principles of human-subject research ethics
Apply Good Clinical Practice concepts to study workflows
Protect participant data and research records
Avoid common authorship, reporting, and publication-integrity failures
fields.requirements:
No prerequisites
Designed for anyone contributing to health research
fields.target_audience: Clinical investigators, research teams, medical writers, students, and ethics professionals
